text: Why can a pool never run dry? Why do lenders earn less than borrowers pay? How did a peg defense become a death spiral? One DeFi formula like these every day in my new thread.
One number decides whether your DeFi loan gets liquidated, and someone gets paid to do it. My new daily thread explains formulas like this one, from swaps to stablecoins.

text: Swaps, then lending, then stablecoins, oracles and vaults: I started a daily thread opening the formula behind each piece of DeFi, readable without being a dev.

The app shows a price, an APY, a dollar. Behind each one is a formula with edge cases, and some broke in public: the bZx attack, Black Thursday, Terra. I'm opening them one a day in a new DeFi thread.
